active_parameter_count_definition: shared parameters plus all routers plus top-k complete expert matrices; stored parameters include all experts
experiment_role: 124M-active dense complete-expert sparse-MoE control; implementation and MFU qualification precede any scientific launch
mfu_measurement_protocol: foreground real CUDA BF16 training-path preflight with one warmup and four timed updates; execute deterministic dropless top-2 routing, batched expert GEMMs, per-expert batched Muon, router AdamW, and both router auxiliary losses
monitoring_policy: MFU preflight is foreground-polled with no watchdog; a scientific 0.5TPP run is estimated under two hours and gets one terminal-or-error callback only
prelaunch_provenance_requirements: record Git commit, entrypoint, literal command, config SHA-256, source hashes, dataset manifest, fixed-evaluation identity, MFU certificate, and terminal log/status/checkpoint hashes
selection_endpoint: terminal fixed-evaluation validation CE; training loss includes router auxiliaries and is not a selection metric
